children: Home services platform Urban Company has raised ₹2,500 crore through a Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP), with the company announcing the closure of the issue.
In an exchange filing, Urban Company said it had allotted shares to institutional investors at ₹156 apiece.

The issue price represents a 3% discount to the floor price of ₹161.03 and an 11% discount to the stock's closing price on Thursday. Urban Company had a market capitalisation of ₹27,103 crore as of Thursday's close.
The QIP opened on November 16, 2026, and closed on November 19, 2026.
The fundraise comes as Urban Company faces intensifying competition in the instant house-help segment from Lightspeed-backed Snabbit and General Catalyst-backed Pronto.
Several domestic mutual funds featured among the investors allotted shares in the QIP.
Urban Company shares ended 1.6% higher at ₹175.50 on Thursday. The stock has gained 34% so far this year.

title: Urban Company raises ₹2,500 crore through QIP; MFs, Azim Premji unit issued shares
